name: io.github.DinevDecor/signal-feed-mcp
title: Signal Feed API: market regime
description: Daily market regime (risk-on / risk-off) for trading agents, paid per call via x402 USDC on Base.

environmentVariables.name: X402_BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Hex private key of a small, dedicated buyer wallet with USDC on Base. Without it only the free tools work. Used only to sign locally; never logged or sent.

environmentVariables.name: SIGNAL_FEED_MAX_PAID_CALLS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum paid calls per server run (0.10 USDC each).

environmentVariables.name: SIGNAL_FEED_PREFLIGHT
environmentVariables.description: Optional Agent Trust payment preflight before signing: off, block or allow-only.

environmentVariables.name: SIGNAL_FEED_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Agent id sent to the preflight.

environmentVariables.name: SIGNAL_FEED_AUTHORITY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a signed delegation (authority envelope) sent to the preflight.
